evidence.description: Direct access to User.shared.news for assignment

candidates.explanation: The component accesses the 'User.shared' singleton directly to retrieve the 'news' property, creating a hard-coded dependency that is difficult to isolate or mock.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

candidates.explanation: The code uses a force unwrap (!) on a Date component result without establishing a reliable guarantee that the value cannot be nil.
candidates.title: Unjustified Force Unwrapping
